William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Art and Artists

When Sir Joshua Reynolds died

XXI
W
HEN
 Sir Joshua Reynolds died
All Nature was degraded;
The King dropp’d a tear into the Queen’s ear,
And all his pictures faded.
